scripts.build: vp exec astro build && node scripts/generate-csp-hashes.mjs
scripts.db:generate: vp exec auth generate --config src/better-auth/schema.ts --output migrations/0001-initial.sql --yes
scripts.db:migrate: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrate:local: vp exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.deploy:staging: vp exec wrangler versions upload --preview-alias staging --var AUTH_ORIGIN:https://staging-triad-auth.equator-owl-studio.workers.dev
scripts.preview: vp run build && vp exec astro preview
